motion.attachment: RGBA16F: unjittered UV velocity.xy, previous linear depth, MSAA coverage; R16F: current linear depth; normalize both by coverage
limits: analytic rest-mesh wind and camera motion only; no arbitrary model-matrix animation
missing-coverage bridge retains conservative camera-only fallback

bloom.model: single threshold-free linear HDR PSF with positive6sigma separable Gaussian after each downsample; at most1.8% radiance redistribution
bloom.flareScope: visible input image only; finite sensor crop, no offscreen-source/lens-tracing/occlusion inference

hdr.shoulder: same fitted SDR ACES anchor through exposed peak 1; C1 bounded highlight extension; nit scale divided by browser/Windows SDR white
hdr.limits: System-reported luminance is not a photometer measurement and scene lux is not calibrated. This is not an official ACES HDR ODT. Extended sRGB canvas is not a native 80-nit scRGB swap chain. External-image copy is not guaranteed zero-copy. PBO copies pixels through CPU. HDR enlargement is linear, not SDR FSR1.

lens.antialias: MSAA + leaf temporal + water temporal + SMAA

temporal.scope: analytic wind/camera foliage motion, MSAA coverage, independent short water radiance history
temporal.metadata: R8 age; nearest valid depth, bilinear RGB

fireworks.model: analytic linear-drag segments; deterministic world-space events; authored reference photometry, not CFD
fireworks.capacityPolicy: complete events, immediate acceptance or explicit rejection; automatic full slots skip without queue
fireworks.clusterIlluminationModel: spatial-moment finite-radius point proxy; not exact area emission

contactSupport.scope: air-source centre support over static terrain/mean sea; finite root brackets; smoke and material unchanged

radianceBound.method: 32x32 conservative source overlap bins; actual pixel-integrated Gaussian peak and projected shutter/stretch extent; near crossings cover viewport; legacy globalFiniteSurfaceCeiling is a spherical reference only; root separately budgets ambient/air/receivers

fireworks.units: reference cd + approximate emission RGB, linear scene reference once *2^storageEV; not measured pyrotechnic photometry
fireworks.renderer: independent instanced premult effects, four-segment finite air; water-hit reflection origin; sorted short segments

tailIntegration.kernelEvaluations: upper limits256 local spatial evaluations /768 with large shutter; projected counters are CPU estimates, not actual GPU execution counts

limits: linear drag/burn model; no chemical or shock/fluid solve
grey smoke thin sprites; centre-depth sorting and shared near-air visibility approximation
resolved opaque depth/defocus occlusion approximation; root owns one shared bloom/vignette
subpixel tail shutter variance is a bounded angular approximation, not exact time-space convolution
star/cross-spectrum RGB is approximate CIE fit + authored bands and gamut compression
